component.name: satchel
component.summary: Share the clipboard and files by code phrase

description.p: Croc-style sharing from your system tray. Share the clipboard — text or an image — or files and whole folders, and send the link it copies for you. The other side opens it in a browser, or types the code phrase into their satchel, and it arrives end-to-end encrypted through a relay that cannot read it.

ul.li: Anyone can receive in a browser, with nothing installed
Pair a device once, then send to it by name; it is always asked first
Received files never overwrite, and every item's SHA-256 is checked
Start a video call with confab, and invite a paired device to it

description.p: First Flatpak release, replacing the AppImage.
